blog: Copy text from the screen in Windows 11
title: Copy text you can't select
problem: The words are in a paused video, a slide or a scan, and you can't select them.
old: [[Win+Shift+S]], paste the picture into an OCR website, or type it out again.
way: Flick to Screen text and drag over it. The text is on your clipboard. Windows' own OCR reads it; nothing is uploaded.

title: Every open window, by name
problem: Twenty windows open, and Alt+Tab is a wall of tiny pictures.
old: [[Alt+Tab]], [[Alt+Tab]], [[Alt+Tab]]… past the one you wanted.
way: Put the ring on your mouse's thumb button. Rest on Windows: every open window shows up by name. Flick to the one you want.

title: Someone walks up to your desk
problem: Everything on your screen, in plain view, right now.
old: [[Win+D]], if you remember it in time.
way: Flick to Show desktop: every window goes down. Pick it again and they all come back. Lock sits right next to it.

title: Volume on the scroll wheel
problem: The volume slider is down in the corner, two clicks away, every time.
old: Click the speaker in the tray, drag the slider, click away.
way: Rest on Volume and turn the mouse wheel; the ring stays open while it changes. Click it to mute.

title: Keep a window above everything
problem: The video call, the calculator or the recipe keeps disappearing behind other windows.
old: Install PowerToys, then [[Win+Ctrl+T]].
way: Flick to Always on top in the window you are in. Again to let it go. Nothing else to install.

title: Bring back the tab you just closed
problem: You closed the tab you still needed.
old: [[Ctrl+Shift+T]], which almost nobody knows.
way: Hold the middle button and flick to Reopen tab. Your scroll wheel is a button too.

blog: What Windows' clipboard can and can't do
title: Paste without the website's fonts
problem: You paste into an e-mail and get the web page's fonts, colours and links too.
old: [[Ctrl+Shift+V]] in some apps, nothing in others, or paste into Notepad and copy again.
way: Flick to Paste plain: only the text lands, in any program.

title: Share a link without the trackers
problem: The link you are about to send is 300 characters of utm_, fbclid and gclid.
old: Click into the address, find where the junk starts, delete it by hand.
way: Copy it, flick to Clean link: the short, clean address is pasted.

title: Fix TEXT THAT SHOUTS
problem: A whole heading or a paragraph arrived in capitals.
old: Delete it and type it again. Word has [[Shift+F3]]; most programs have nothing.
way: Copy, flick to Title Case, Sentence case or lowercase. The fixed text is pasted.

blog: Windows' clipboard history and its limits
title: Paste what you copied five minutes ago
problem: You copied something new and lost the thing you copied before.
old: [[Win+V]], Windows' clipboard history. It has to be turned on first, and few people know it is there.
way: Put Clipboard history on your ring: one flick, no key to remember. RadialDeck's own history ring is Pro.

title: Excel pasted formulas, not numbers
problem: You copied totals into another sheet and got #REF! everywhere.
old: [[Ctrl+Alt+V]], [[V]], [[Enter]], or the little paste menu.
way: Flick to Paste values: the numbers, without the formulas.

blog: Excel shortcuts that save the most time
title: Excel printed your table on 4 pages again
problem: One column spilled onto its own page, and the printer is already going.
old: Page Layout, Scale to Fit, Width: 1 page, Height: 1 page. Or [[Alt P S P]], then Fit to.
way: Flick to Fit to one page before you print. The sheet is set to one page wide and one tall.

blog: Excel shortcuts that save the most time
title: Columns full of ######
problem: The numbers are there, but every column is too narrow to show them.
old: Double-click every column border, or [[Alt H O I]].
way: Select the columns and flick to AutoFit: each one fits what is in it.

blog: Excel shortcuts that save the most time
title: The same name three times in your list
problem: A mailing list or a stock list full of repeats.
old: Data, Remove Duplicates, or [[Alt A M]].
way: Flick to Dedupe and press OK: Excel's own Remove Duplicates, every name exactly once.

title: The same reply, ten times a day
problem: "Thank you, I will get back to you by Friday", typed again and again.
old: Set up Quick Steps, or copy the text from an old e-mail every time.
way: Flick to Reply with a template: the reply opens with your text already in it. Edit the text once, in the ring.

title: Unmute while everyone waits
problem: Someone asks you a question, and the Teams window is behind three others.
old: Find the Teams window, then [[Ctrl+Shift+M]]. It only works while Teams is in front.
way: Flick to Microphone on/off ([[Win+Alt+K]]) from whatever window you are in. Works in Teams and other apps that support it.

title: AutoCAD: everything back on screen
problem: You zoomed into a detail and lost the rest of the drawing.
way: Hold right-click, flick to Zoom extents. It types the command, Enter included.

title: AutoCAD: a DWG full of unused layers
problem: The file is huge, slow to open, and full of blocks and layers nobody uses.
old: PURGE, tick the boxes, Purge All, confirm each one, and again for nested items.
way: Flick to Purge: every unused block, layer, style and linetype goes in one go, without the dialog.

title: The link to a file that colleagues can open
problem: You sent Z:\Projects\Offer.pdf and it does not open on their PC.
old: Find out what Z: is mapped to and type \\server\share\… by hand.
way: Select the file, flick to Copy path as \\server\share: the path that works for everyone is on the clipboard.

title: PDF too big to e-mail
problem: The mail server says the attachment is too large.
old: Upload the PDF to a compression website and hope nobody reads it.
way: Select it, flick to Shrink PDF: a smaller copy lands next to it (27.1 MB became 2.6 MB in our test). Uses the free Ghostscript; your original stays.

title: Five scanned pages as one PDF
problem: The scanner gave you five JPGs, and they want one PDF.
old: Open Word, insert the pictures one by one, save as PDF.
way: Select the images, flick to Images to one PDF: scans.pdf appears in the folder. It uses Word to lay them out.

title: Video too big to send
problem: A 90 MB phone video, and the limit is 10 MB.
old: Upload it to a converter site, or learn a video editor.
way: Drag the video, tap Shift, drop it on 10 MB: it shrinks to fit, on your PC. The drop ring is Pro; the same recipe on a normal ring is free. Uses the free FFmpeg.

title: iPhone photos nothing opens
problem: The photos came as .HEIC, and the form only takes JPG.
old: Upload them to a converter website, one by one.
way: Drag the photos, tap Shift, drop them on JPG. Done on your PC; the files never leave it. HEIC needs Microsoft's free HEIF extension.

title: The taskbar froze
problem: The Start button and the taskbar stopped reacting to clicks.
old: [[Ctrl+Shift+Esc]], find Windows Explorer in the list, right-click, Restart.
way: Flick to Restart Explorer: the taskbar comes back in a second, your open programs stay.

title: Every Windows setting in one list
problem: The setting you need moved between Control Panel and Settings again.
old: Know the secret "God Mode" folder: a folder named with a long code that Windows opens as one list.
way: Flick to All settings: every Control Panel task in one searchable window.
